subject: Add to compute DELTA11: 4 missing selectors from integration's QuartzCore selector gate
body: Implement on TeguComputeDevice/TeguBuffer: newBufferWithBytesNoCopy:length:options:deallocator: (real no-copy only if the region can be wrapped exactly by the existing BO import path with alignment rules; otherwise return nil — never copy silently), newLinearTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow:bytesPerImage: (exact linear texture view of the buffer via existing texture layout helpers, or nil), newResourceGroupFromResources:count: (return nil if no residency model; document), encodeCacheHint: (no-op). Keep deviceLinearReadOnlyTextureAlignmentBytes consistent with what newLinearTexture accepts. Also: rebuild the host cdylib for the new *_tg planner symbols as soon as possible (integration is blocked on it). Host tests.
